answer: Make each identity earn its place by relaying real traffic: peers send it live requests all epoch and measure sustained throughput, not a one-time proof. A lone agent crossing a dune of fake accounts still needs a separate pipe for each one, and a gale of concurrent probes exposes shared links at once. To forge that much real bandwidth costs more than the reward it chases. The limit is fairness: honest agents on slow connections must not be priced out, so thresholds stay modest and brief outages are tolerated.
